Shoot out a blade of water which flies in a straight line.

Active
[Active - Press] - Shoots a blade-shaped water projectile that deals 40 HP in damage and moves at 120 blocks per second and costs 10 MP. Requires the user to be underwater or have a spatial storage-type skill with water inside of it, which consumes one bottles worth of water on each use (1 water point).

Remove the requirement of air underwater.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] - Allows you to breath underwater

Propel yourself at high speeds underwater.

Active
[Active - Press] - Grants a boost effect similar to the riptide enchantment that can only be used underwater. Hitting an enemy during riptide effect will deal damage equal to players attack damage. It’s activated by the user and costs 2MP to activate

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Increases damage dealt by Water related attacks by 3x. Mastery grants Water attack resistance/nullification degradation if the user has 800k EP. Doesn't stack with Water Manipulation
Active
[ Active - Press/Hold ] - When sneaking: Shoot a water ball dealing 12 damage with knockback if in water or has water points in spatial storage (1 water point each) - Cost 100MP.
Not Sneaking: “Breath Water” (deal 8 damage each sec) if in water, in rain or has water points in spatial storage (1 water point each 5s) - Cost 10MP each sec.
Using on concrete powder will instantly convert to concrete.
Increase magic casting speed multiplier by 2, increase movement speed by 0.01 (0.02 with Mastery), increase attack speed by 0.2 (0.4 with Mastery)

Send commands to nearby allies and become able to have them attack players.

Active
[Active - Press] - Movement Behaviour: Activate when looking at an entity in 30 block radius, if that’s a subordinate, cycle through stay/follow/wander modes, if that’s a non-ally target, all subordinate in the range of 30x30x30 radius around the user will start to attack that target. If shifted when activating, cycle through stay/follow/wander modes of all subordinates in 30x30x30 radius. [In wander mode, the subordinate will wander 50 block around the position where it is set to Wander.]
Active: [Active - Press] - Targeting Behavior [Require Mastery]: Activate when looking at a subordinate in 30 block radius, if that’s a subordinate, cycle through neutral/passive/aggressive/protect modes. If shifted when activating, cycle through neutral/passive/aggressive/protect modes of all subordinates in 30x30x30 radius. [While neutral, the subordinate will defend when attacked and the owner attacked or is attacked. In passive mode, it will not target anything even if got hit. While being aggressive, the subordinate will target everything that is not an ally. In protect mode, it will target everything that is targeting its owner or ally.]

You should have listened when we said to cut back.

Active
[Active] Titanification: When activated, increases the players height by 6 blocks. Lasts for 2 minutes and grants the player +60 Attack Damage and +20 Armor (Speed, Jump Strength and Attack/Mining reach increases according to size change).
Active: While active the player is completely immune to all magic attacks unless they come from someone with over twice their ep.
Active: When mastered, gain the ability to choose size modification among [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 blocks] increase while still keep the buff effect. Sneak-activate to turn off

HERE, TAKE MY GLORIOUS STUFF! (I like these texts)

Active
[Active, Press] Generosity - Create a circle of amplification in front of the user that raises the damage of any projectiles passing through it by 3 times. If a player passes through this gate, they will experience heightened speed and step height for 10 seconds. Every entity or player that passes through this gate contributes to [Pay It Forward]. The user cannot use the gate to amplify themselves or their projectiles/attacks. Only one circle can be active at a time and persists until the user takes it down. Costs 1000 MP to spawn a circle and 500 MP every second it is active. Shift and Use to remove the circle.
Active: [Active, Toggle] Pay It Forward - Every Contribution you have gained will be consumed to power up Pay It Forward. The duration of this mode depends on how many Contributions have been made, following this formula (Contributions x 10 seconds)
Toggling off the mode preserves the remaining seconds for future use.
When Pay It Forward is active, the user will gain Damage Amplification and hugely boosted Speed and Step Height depending on the number of Contributions counted.
30 or more contributions - 2x Damage, +0.1F movement speed and +2 Step Height.
50 or more - 3x Damage, +0.15F movement speed and +3 Step Height.
100 or more - 5x Damage, +0.2F movement speed and +4 Step Height.
500 or more - 10x Damage, +0.5F movement speed and +6 Step Height.

Project your otherworldly gaze to see all nearby entities and partially ignore dodging abilities.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] - Highlights all mobs/players in a 30x30 area in blue, even ones under disguising skills. Grants a 50% chance to ignore dodging abilities (except Future Sight).

Improve your senses to be able to see in the dark or even spot invisible entities nearby.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] - Grant the player a Night Vision effect, the ability to see Invisible players, and mobs in a 30 radius are highlighted in blue. Costs 5MP per 20 Ticks.

3 Modes. Costs 1000 MP to use. Needs to be directly under the sky. 10 second cooldown, 5 when mastered.
Active
[Active - Press] Clear Weather: Clears any weather and makes the sky clear.
Active: [Active - Press] Rain: Sets the weather to Rain.
Active: [Active - Press] Storm: Sets the weather to Thunderstorm.

3 Modes. Costs 500 MP to use. 5 second cooldown, 3 when mastered.
Active
[Active - Press] Clear Weather: Clears any weather and makes the sky clear.
Active: [Active - Press] Rain: Sets the weather to Rain.
Active: [Active - Press] Storm: Sets the weather to Thunderstorm.

Costs 80 MP every second, While held down and looking at a mob within 20 blocks of the player, inflict them with 1 level of a status effect each 15 secs and add 10 seconds for every 5 seconds that pass. 5 Modes.
Corrosion
Poison
Paralysis
Insanity

Flip the rules. Change alignments, invert buffs and debuffs while shifting strengths and weaknesses to your benefit.

Active
[Active - Press] - Inverted Fusion [Buff]: When activated, removes all negative status effects (besides some exception like Magicule Poisoning) from the player if looking at nothing or the looked at mob/player and grants buffs based on the status effect removed (if applicable). Paralysis, Slowness = Speed; Poison, Corrosion, Wither = Regeneration; Burden = Slow Falling + Speed + Jump Boost; Fragility = Resistance; Mining Fatigue = Haste, Hunger = Saturation; Bad Luck = Luck, Weakness = Strength, Night Vision = Blindness/Darkness, Invisibility = Glowing etc. It can also turn Curses from gear into Blessings when the skill is mastered or completely erase those curses if they don't have a blessing counterpart
Active: [Active - Press] - Inverted Fusion [Debuff]: Invert the possible reverse Above
Inverted fusion becomes toggleable with mastery. Once toggled, it will automatically inverse any negative effect applied.
Reversing now respects the ratio of reversed effects (for example, Resistance = Fragility II).
Can reverse effects on potion items on entities with mastery.
Active: [Active - Press] - Alignment Reverse: If the player is a Majin, Holy or True Hero(TH), sets Alignment to Chaos (Which can be seen as it changes the Race name color to Red). When the alignment is set to Chaos, the player can become TH when their race is Majin. Chaos-aligned beings are no longer affected by Holy Coat, and no longer take extra damage from Charybdis's Wicked Light Ray. With Mastery, you can set the alignment of other players or mobs to Chaos.

Go into a 3rd person mode, which increases your POV and grants movement and action buffs as well as an upgrade to Presence Sense.

Active
[Active - Hold] - When holding down, locks the play into a 360° View, abit further zoomed out than regular 3rd person. While active, grants the player +0.02 Speed, +0.5 Swim Speed, + 0.1 Attack Speed & Mining Speed [equal to Haste 1] buff, increases Presence Sense Level by 1 if there’s any and increases the block radius of Presence Sense skills by 10 blocks. When mastered, this becomes toggleable and gives 10% dodge chance, but if used by holding down, double the boost on speed and presence sense radius. Costs 10 MP per 20 ticks.

Stagnate the world around you, could this be a jojo reference...?

Active
[Active, Hold] Stagnate Aura - Costs 500 mp/s. While held, entities within a 25 block radius of the user cannot move or use physical/aura attacks. Mental/Magical/Skill based ones can still be used.
Active: [Active, Hold] Inaction - Costs 100mp/s. While Held, the user cannot move or use physical/aura based attacks, but can also not have their current HP reduced (SHP can still be reduced. Effects like that of Cook’s chaotic Fate can bypass this.)
Active: [Active, Toggle] Stasis Coat - When used, grants severance to the user’s melee attacks, as well as +10 damage.
Active: [Active, Press] Stasis Shot - Costs 1000 mp. User launches an Air Projectile that Bypasses Armor, doing 5 damage and severing the target’s HP. The Projectile travels at a speed of 25 m/s Cooldown of 20 Seconds {This mode must be learned}

Empower and command your allies, and then collect their abilities once they pass on.

Passive
[Passive - True]: Skill Collection: When an ally dies within 20 blocks of the user, the user can collect their Resistance/Intrinsic/Common/Extra/Unique Skills.
Passive: [Passive - In Slot]: Allies do 10 extra damage and +0.02 Speed, +1 Swim Speed, +5 Armor (Double buff with Mastery)
Active
[Active - Press] Thought Domination: Allows the player to command their subordinates, including a "Meat Shield" Option.

Use your skill and your precision to throw anything and deal massive damage. You can even shove air or push back your foes.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] - Homing Projectile: Item thrown by user will be homing toward where the user’s looking at or lock on into a target and chase them (max range 50-blocks).
Passive: [Passive - True] - User deals much more damage using Kunai, Spear & Trident instead of their default damage.
Active
[Active - Press] - Throw: When activated, consumes the currently held item and creates a projectile with its texture as a model.
The projectile deals 50 (100 if mastery, damage boosted with Gravity Domination/Manipulation toggled by x3/x2) damage,
if the item is a weapon, then it deals its normal damage too.
If the thrown item is a block breaking tool, it will break blocks based on the broken block and tool level(Max breakable blocks in a row is 10,configurable).
Items with elemental cores will deal elemental damage as well(Not boosted by manipulations or dominations).
If used with an empty hand, creates an air projectile that deals 30 damage (50 with mastery).
If activated while looking at an enemy within 2 blocks of the player, flings them 15 blocks instead (further with Gravity Manipulation/Domination toggled).
Thrown item's momentum is boosted by the players momentum. Costs 40 MP each usage.
Mastery
Thrown items (not arrows, tridents, kunais,...) have Loyalty effect
If the player has Gravity Manipulation/Domination there is a higher return speed
